title: Continuous module encoding commutes with restriction along an etale morphism
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite-dimensional normed extension of Q_ell, f:Y -> X an etale morphism of schemes, and P an internal module over the condensed continuous E coefficient ring. For the specified encoding FE of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-module-encoding], the underlying module presheaf of FE_Y(f*P), with canonical internal inverse image, is isomorphic to the restriction of FE_X(P) along lisseEtaleCoefficientIdentification of [def-weil-pbc-lisse-lattice-coefficients]. More generally, for a totally disconnected commutative topological ring T and weakly etale f, the unnormalized continuous encoding commutes with restriction along the identity map on continuous-function coefficient sections.

proof.text: Use the source-library upperStarIsoSheafPushforward specialized to abelian sheaves, together with its proved monoidal instance. This is the same localization restriction comparison as in continuousChart_pullback. The current upstream InternalHom module can now be imported without the former duplicate laxBraided_upperStar declaration.

Apply the monoidal localization comparison to the internal module. Conjugate by the invertible continuous-chart coefficient maps; continuousChart_pullback identifies the conjugated coefficient map with the identity map on continuous functions. Apply mapModNatIso and the section-module encoding. Evaluating the natural multiplication map proves the resulting sectionwise isomorphism is linear.

Compare the two pullback functors obtained from the division-ring and commutative-ring projections of the normed coefficient field by reflexivity, before evaluating them on P. Apply the induced isomorphism on P through the continuous encoding, then compose with continuousRing_module_restriction. Transport the continuous coefficient rings through lisseFieldSheaf_eq: coefficientCast_app identifies their components, and pushforwardComp turns the commuting coefficient square into an isomorphism of the restricted module presheaves. The proved equality for the continuousFieldModuleEquivalence functor completes the rational restriction theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousField_module_restriction
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E]
    [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f]
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X)) :
    Nonempty (((continuousFieldModuleEquivalence ℓ E Y).functor.obj
        ((upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) f).obj P)).val ≅
      (PresheafOfModules.pushforward (lisseEtaleCoefficientIdentification ℓ E f)).obj
        ((continuousFieldModuleEquivalence ℓ E X).functor.obj P).val)
